_readme: serviceName -> forward target(s). A service matches when an event's serviceName equals its key or one of its aliases (case-insensitive), or when client_reference_id starts with '<key>:'. Entries with enabled:false are documentation only and never receive traffic. Optional 'accounts' restricts a service to events arriving on those /api/stripe/webhook/:account paths.

tarot.source: projects/divination/tarot/api/src/server.js new StripeService('JarvisBee Tarot'); host from tarot-cards/public/js/config/api.js

rigor.source: projects/rigor/api. serviceName='rigor' is now set on checkout session + subscription metadata. Subscriptions created before that change carry no serviceName: map their price ids to 'rigor' in ROUTE_PRICE_MAP (same values as rigor's STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_IDS / STRIPE_TEAM_PRICE_IDS).
